caption: The drawing depicts a wooden dresser with three drawers, each featuring two round knobs for handles, all colored in shades of brown suggesting a wood grain texture. On top of the dresser, there is an attached rectangular mirror with a beveled wooden frame, also brown, and decorative wooden side panels that rise and curve upward on both sides of the mirror. The dresser stands on four short legs, with the front legs having a slightly curved decorative cut. The background of the drawing is plain off-white, and there are no other objects or decorations present in the image.
title: Doll's Dresser
